94a152a7e454.title: Software Engineer Intern - (Summer 2027)
94a152a7e454.description_html:
The Voleon Group is a quantitative hedge fund headquartered in Berkeley, CA. We apply statistical machine learning to get an edge in highly competitive, fast-moving financial markets. We employ world-class engineering and research talent to solve financial prediction problems.

We are seeking passionate software engineers who can tackle hard problems in a high-stakes environment. You should be a highly motivated individual who can push a project through to completion, as well as demonstrate excellence in designing clean, robust software.  

 

At Voleon, software engineers design and build complex, high-performance systems such as:

   - Real-time trading systems

   - Large-scale distributed data processing

   - Research infrastructure to develop the next generation of machine learning models

   - and much more

 

You will have the opportunity to work closely with machine learning researchers, trading staff, and engineers.  You will gain exposure to the full “finance stack," learning about a broad range of areas including machine learning, the mechanics of institutional trading, market execution dynamics, and more.

 

We are open to accepting interns who can start in summer 2027. 

 

Responsibilities

  • Designing complex systems.

  • Take on a lot of responsibility very quickly.  You will “own” your work (passionately).

Requirements

  • Expected to graduate in 2028

  • Hands-on experience writing code: You have built something significant. You understand how to write modular, maintainable, well-organized, and thoughtfully structured code.

  • Mastery of Computer Science fundamentals.

  • Modern software practices: You are comfortable using Linux, git, and mainstream databases.  

  • You are familiar with cloud infrastructure.

  • You are incredibly good at at least one thing.

  • You are eager to work in diverse teams.

  • You are available to work a full-time internship during the summer, fall, or winter of 2027.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The Voleon Group is an Equal Opportunity employer.
